## Installation and setup
Run:
```bash
docker pull giswqs/geemap
```

and

```bash
docker run -it --name 'geemap' -p 8888:8888 -v '/Users/gregorygiuliani/gis/geemap/':/home/jovyan/work giswqs/geemap:latest
```
